entities.name: Demonic Leviathan
entities.description: A demonic-leviathan planeswalker who fought Nicol Bolas on young Dominaria; Bolas devoured its remains.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon who defeated the leviathan by touch and feasted on its remains.

entities.name: Shattering of Madara
entities.description: Result of the fight, which reduced Madara to a third of its size and created the first temporal rift.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: Land reduced to a third of its size by the fight.

entities.name: Talon Gates
entities.description: What remained of the leviathan after Bolas's feast.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Young plane where the fight took place.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas fought the demonic-leviathan planeswalker for a month, causing the Shattering of Madara.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas caused the Shattering of Madara fighting a demonic - leviathan planeswalker

events.summary: Bolas defeated the leviathan with his touch and then feasted on its remains for over a year, absorbing its power.
events.quote: After the battle Bolas feasted on the remains of the leviathan for over a year

relations.note: Defeated it by touch and devoured its remains.
relations.quote: the dragon relied upon his touch to defeat his foe
